name: fix-e2e-seed-expectations
body: source: native-ci-verification / native-e2e-ci expected "the two starter slides" and theme assets "served from the binary"; ey-employees said "built-in templates"; inconsistency: the seed has one `hello` slide and themes are no longer embedded (only reveal.js core is); resolution: e2e now expects the single hello slide, reveal.js from the embedded core and theme.css from the project's templates/themes/default/; ey-employees reworded to the project's template library.
